imports.detail: standard library maths/containers, numpy, arcengine only

calls.detail: no file, eval or import-hook calls

load.detail: Vh17() loads and RESET renders a 64x64 frame

win_trace.detail: clears all 7 levels in 101 actions and ends in WIN

determinism.detail: two fresh replays produce identical frames

reset.detail: RESET restores each level exactly, keeps completed levels, and the level is winnable after it

level1_short.detail: the recorded level-1 win takes 6 actions (limit 10)

level1_safe.detail: 0 of 24 random runs of up to 150 actions reached GAME_OVER on level 1

early_death.detail: share of random runs that reach GAME_OVER within 10 actions: L1 0%, L2 0%, L3 0%, L4 0%, L5 0%, L6 0%, L7 0% (limit 10%)

random_resistance.detail: random runs of 250 actions (retrying after GAME_OVER) that cleared the level: L2 0/40, L3 0/40, L4 0/40, L5 0/40, L6 0/40, L7 0/40

fuzz.detail: 65280 random actions: no exception, every frame valid

frames_per_action.detail: longest action plays 3 frames (warn over 15, fail over 60; the site plays ~30 per second)

visible_response.detail: share of random actions with no visible change, by action: {3: 0.49, 4: 0.5, 6: 0.4}

random.mode: uniform over available actions; clicks split between anywhere, a random on-screen colour, and engine click targets
